\begin{table}[p]
\caption{Matched-control results. Lone trap: blocker freed within 120\,s from 60 corrected-forward deadlock snapshots (Lone: 34 lone keystone; Second: 26 with a second trap), paired against C3 RVO2 by snapshot. Noise rows count runs (5 seeds per snapshot) and C1 + noise is abbreviated noise; vs C3 RVO2 gives discordant counts with the exact McNemar $p$, or the paired rate difference $\Delta$ for noise; $t_{1/2}$ is the Kaplan--Meier median time-to-free; Replay counts $10^{-9}$\,m replays that differ from the unperturbed run, or for noise the snapshots whose seeds disagree; $J$ is the Jaccard overlap of the snapshots left unresolved with those C3 RVO2 leaves unresolved. Signature rows: $\ell=\ln\hat\lambda(0.005)/\hat\lambda(0.02)$ against the Arrhenius prediction with the exact discrete $k_BT_{\rm eff}$ (mean over 20 snapshots; slope of observed on predicted through the origin, 95\% CI); the Arrhenius ratio is the fitted slope of $\ln\hat\lambda$ against $1/k_BT_{\rm eff}$ over $-\Delta U_{\rm cond}$ (median over snapshots), and $k$ the pooled Weibull shape. Whole runs: completion within 600\,s with Wilson intervals; $\Delta$ is the paired difference from C3 RVO2 (Newcombe interval); failures gives the seeds that fail in one arm only (C3 RVO2 : noise) with the exact McNemar $p$; $J$ is the Jaccard overlap of the failing seeds, with its expectation for independent failures; KM is the Kaplan--Meier median completion time; classes count the rebuilt final states as lone keystone / with a second trap / collective; stalls are intervals of at least 10\,s without an exit.}
